lines.en: You really don't have his phone number?
I told you I have the number that rings here.
I might have it in here.
It's so random that I have it.
When I put it in, I thought it might be a waste of time,
but I guess it was worth it.
It's under here as security guard home.
Did you not get his name?
This is Jim Halpert from, um, where you work.
You are the guy who sits behind the desk.
I mean, you're, uh, who I got here?
All right, so Hank is going to come down here.
He's going to let us all out.
He said it should be just under an hour, so we did it.
We should all make sure to give him a big tip this Christmas.
Sorry, guys, but I don't think I tipped him for last year's.
Jim was supposed to collect it.
No, he's never going to come.
By show of hands, who thinks we're a better couple than Jim and Pam?
Hey, look what I found in the back.
I can teach you to throw.
I know how to throw a football.
Still haven't left the house yet, huh?
Stop calling me so I can put on my damn socks.
Actually, it's kind of too bad we're not coming in to work tomorrow.
I bet Michael had some elaborate theme party planned, like this.
I don't know how to do this.
Is there some elaborate theme party planned, like scrambled eggs Saturday?
Let's get your boss laid Saturday.
I have an announcement to make.
I am moving to Costa Rica.
I've thought about it for a long time now, and I'm finally going to do it.
So, I'm just going to hop the fence and jog home now.
I don't know how to do it.
